## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e9ba427a92090d0be152ab1bf06380b4bf0f1150`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md, docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md, docs/adr/README.md + none
Security-touching: yes

PR #36921 (card #36891, epic #36890). Docs only: 3 files, +310 / -14, one commit. Read: the card and its 2 comments, the epic body and its 3 comments, the PR body and net diff against `main`, the 49 check-runs on this head, and the plan cards the text names (#36895, #36896, #36899, #36906, #36907, #36908, #36909) plus #36692's thread for the ruling the ADR cites. The cited code was read on the PR head; nothing was built or run.

`Security-touching: yes` is meant: ADR-0146's new D1 block says the layered comparison is open to "a principal who cannot write" (decision 8), and the D4 block restates where the activation-ledger switch and its gate sit. Neither changes a gate, but both teach permission behaviour, so the low-risk arm does not apply. The PR is Tier H in any case.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept-set or public-surface change.** The diff touches no package, schema, route or generated artifact other than the ADR index. Right.
- **`docs/adr/README.md`** is one regenerated row (ADR-0084's title and status cell). `Lint · docs & code guards` is green on this head, which carries the index check. Right.
- **Type-to-group table (ADR-0084).** Checked against `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` on the head: 32 entries, split 7 data / 7 ui / 2 automation / 7 system / 6 security / 3 ai, each type in the group the table gives it. The 32 names equal `MetadataTypeSchema`'s enum. The registry file is identical at `151e8123`, the PR head and current `origin/main`. `domain` is a required key of the registry entry schema with exactly those six values. Right; the card's acceptance line "no type without a group" holds.
- **Gate verdicts.** 49 check-runs: 26 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Check Changeset` and all `Lint` and `Type Check` jobs are green.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

No changeset, `skip-changeset` label, `Check Changeset` green. `docs/adr/**` ships in no package, so nothing is published. Matches the claim's `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` is empty. SQL push-down: not applicable, no code. Dev flags and out-of-scope notes, each answered:

- **Amendment reaches beyond D1, D3, D4** (D2, D8, D11, Consequences, Rollout, merge questions, Refs). Accepted: the card says to fix every reference to the pillars, all hunks are inside the claimed file, and each is a dated reading that moves no rule (checked hunk by hunk).
- **H1 title of ADR-0084 reworded.** Accepted as drafted item 4; number and file name unchanged, no other file quotes the old title, the index is regenerated.
- **Card item 5 (note on #36513) not posted by the dev.** Still owed by the seat; the suggested text in the dev report matches the amended ADRs.
- **Group names vs #36899 item 8.** The ADR writes 平台 and 访问 for `system` and `security`, as decision 11 rules. #36899 item 8 says to take names from `translateMetadataDomain`, which draws 系统 and 安全. The ADR is right; the seat should put a note on #36899 before it is dispatched, since "noted, not filed" leaves the conflict only in a dev report.
- **Decision 5 gaps** (what the top-left control names when the package publishes no app, and on the two package-less legs). Not a defect of this text, which writes only what was ruled. It is a ruling gap that #36899 will hit; escalate it as a question on #36899 for the maintainer and do not leave it to that dev.
- **D3's "Setup carries nothing per package" vs #36908.** Answered in the text: merge question 15 flags it without choosing.
- **Other docs still describing the pillars** (ADR-0086, ADR-0130, `ui/docs/adr/0056`, `docs/design/builder-ui.md`). Accepted as carried to #36910; they match `main` until the epic's children land. The seat should note it on #36910.
- **`os` stats grouping.** Accepted: the amendment says it is not ruled on.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**Against the rulings.** All fifteen decisions were compared with the text one by one. Decisions 1, 3 to 10 and 12 to 15 are written in ADR-0146 D1's block as the epic states them; decision 11 is in ADR-0084; decision 2 and the open halves of decision 4 are assigned to their cards. The decision 13 passage agrees with the 06:34Z answer, the #36692 ruling 「照 Twenty 分开」, the merged PR #36848 (`e0050baa` on `main`: `reports/new` is linked from the report index, design mode keeps "New dashboard…" only) and epic comment 7125835005. The 08:51Z ruling (no runtime dashboard index) is not contradicted. No sentence contradicts a ruling.

**Against the cited code** (read on the head): `ENVIRONMENT_AREA_TYPES` is permission, position, sharing_rule and capability, all registered `security`; the landing's only `~all` entry is the roles-and-permissions card; `registerUnsavedEdits` and `confirmUnsavedLeave` exist and the module covers tab close, reload, in-app links and button departures but not `popstate`, as the leave-guard bullet says; the datasource tile opens Setup's Datasources page; `field` is hidden from the directory; the pillar address shape and the three query parameters are as written; Setup's Packaged automation and Packaged actions pages are retired.

**Against the execution plan.** #36899 (two frames or one shell left to the dev; `~org`, default sharing overview and diagnostics in the menu), #36896 (list state and scroll restored, ordered names), #36906 and #36907 (three-step app rule, "from Studio" in the address, the two "New" targets), #36908 (landing removed, entries moved first) and #36909 (old pillar addresses keep redirecting) all agree with the text.

**Drafted, not ruled: each placement judged.** None contradicts a ruling.

1. ADR-0084 item 1, `~all` entered from the 访问 Access group. Holds. Decision 11 is silent on it; the leg's directory lists exactly four `security` types, and the three ruled package-less entries each sit in the group of what they hold. The approver should know one fact the item leaves out (N1).
2. ADR-0084 item 2, Settings is not a group. Holds; it follows from decision 11 naming six groups and from the one-type-one-group rule. `app`, `hook`, `mapping` and `datasource` land where the registry puts them.
3. ADR-0084 item 3, group order and English names. Holds; the order is decision 11's own. It differs from today's directory order (N2).
4. ADR-0084 item 4, the title. Holds.
5. ADR-0146 question 13, pillar addresses keep redirecting. Holds; it is the plan of #36909 and the record's own practice for retired routes.
6. ADR-0146 question 14, the readings of D2, D3, D4, D8, D11 and the Consequences. Hold; each changes where a thing is drawn and no rule.
7. ADR-0146 question 15, the home of D3's per-package line left unnamed. Holds; it is a flag, and the text correctly says a Setup home needs its own ruling.

**Nits** (prose face; fix in place or leave as accepted deviations):

- N1 (nit) — ADR-0084 item 1 describes the `~all` leg only as a directory of four Access types. The leg has a second read: `/studio/~all/metadata/TYPE` is the cross-package list of any type (#29566), and Setup's retired metadata routes redirect there (for example the flow list). The Access placement still holds, because the leg's directory draws only the four types, but the item should say so, so the approver rules on the whole leg.
- N2 (nit) — The "The menu" section notes that today's directory uses different words for two groups but not that its order differs (`DOMAIN_ORDER` puts `ai` fourth and `system` last). #36899 reuses that grouping; one clause would stop it inheriting the old order.
- N3 (nit) — ADR-0084 "What Studio is" says Studio "is opened on one package" and "has no page of its own above a package", while the same record lists two package-less entries (`~org` flows, `~all`). "No landing page" would say what decision 9 rules without the tension.
- N4 (nit) — ADR-0146 "One address per item" spells the address for a package only and says the two app-opened types are the exceptions. The `~org` and `~all` segments stand in the package position, and a `datasource` opens Setup's page (as ADR-0084 says); naming both would close the list.
- N5 (nit) — ADR-0146's "New" bullet does not say what the button does when the three-step rule finds no app. #36907 item 3 hides it with a reason; a clause pointing there would match the plan.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36891-studio-left-menu-adr`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzgv4KRPATgwPAzKKMU`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head e9ba427a · 2026-11-24T09:28Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `e9ba427a92090d0be152ab1bf06380b4bf0f1150`
Reviewer: L1-b (seat 3, area ux-E). Contract review: L2 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on this head, comment 7127449959 (claim 7127316191), nits only, `Security-touching: yes` (decision 8 and the D4 switch text teach permission behaviour; no gate moves).
Tier H: `docs/adr/**` is governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 36921`: Tier H, ADR changes that are not add-only notes). This verdict goes to the seat, which hands the PR to the approver. Draft stays draft.

### Read
- Net diff `origin/main...e9ba427a` (3 files, +310/−14), PR body, card #36891 with claim 7125986565 and dev report 7127226133, and epic #36890: body, the fifteen decisions, and comment 7125835005, the decision 13 follow-up.
- Check-runs on `e9ba427a`: 26 success, 23 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. `l1-face.mjs --pr 36921`: CLEAN, 13 items, none flagged. `skip-changeset`: right, no package ships `docs/adr/**`.

### Checklist
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36891`, plus `Part of #36890`, which is not a closing keyword.
- **Scope.** Three files: the two ADRs and the generated `docs/adr/README.md` row. All three are inside the claim surface. No code.
- **Type → group table against the registry.** Read on the head from `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`, pairing each `type` with its `domain` in order: data 7 (`field hook mapping object object_extension picklist seed`), ui 7 (`action app dashboard dataset page report view`), automation 2 (`flow job`), system 7 (`api book datasource doc email_template external_catalog translation`), security 6 (`assignment_rule capability permission position queue sharing_rule`), ai 3 (`agent skill tool`). That is 32 in all. Every row of the ADR-0084 table matches this, type for type. The rule "a type's group is its registered `domain`" makes the table hold for any type added later.
- **Against the fifteen decisions.** Each decision is written where the ADR-0146 D1 table says it is. I checked these against the epic's wording:
  - Decision 11: six groups, 平台 = `system`, 访问 = `security`, agent/tool/skill under AI; `~org` under Automation, the default sharing overview under Access, diagnostics under Platform.
  - Decision 12: Back is not intercepted; ×, ‹ ›, the menu, links, refresh and close are.
  - Decision 13: dashboard → design mode "Add menu item → Dashboard"; report → `/apps/<app>/reports/new`. This is decision 13 exactly as the epic records it. #36848 is on main (`e0050baa`).
  - Decisions 5, 6 and 10 are written as ruled.
  - Decision 2 is correctly left to #36894 and #36898.
- **Drafted, not ruled.** The seven placements are numbered in their records and listed in the body for the approver. None contradicts a ruling I can find. Item 1 (`~all` under Access) follows decision 11's own rule (the group of what an entry holds), and the directory's four types are all `security`. Item 7 flags a choice and does not make it.
- **Gates.** ADR symbol anchors, links, index and anchors all exit 0 in the body (+6 anchors, +5 links over baseline), and Lint & Repo Gates is success on the head.
- **Card acceptance.** (1) ADR text matches the epic's decisions: met (above). (2) The table covers every registered type, none without a group: met, 32 of 32. (3) The ADR and docs checks pass: met. Card item 5 (a note on #36513) is a GitHub comment, not part of this diff; see the note to the seat.

### Findings
No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N1 (nit).** ADR-0146 D1, the report bullet of "New": "The answer above named design mode for both lists" is narrower than the record. The epic logs the 06:34Z answer as 「新建跳到设计模式加菜单」 together with "（报表一半按决定 13 对齐 #36692）", and decision 13 itself names `/apps/<app>/reports/new` for a report. The conclusion the ADR draws is the same; only the framing reads as if the ADR reconciles a conflict that the decision already settled. The approver may leave it.
- The L2 record adds N1–N5 on the prose face (notably N1: the `~all` leg is also the cross-package list of any type, which item 1 should say so the approver rules on the whole leg). I adopt them as nits.

### Note to the seat
- `Fixes #36891` closes the card at merge. Card item 5 (the note on #36513) is not in the diff; the dev report 7127226133 carries the exact text for the seat to post. Post it before the approver merges, so the card does not close with item 5 undone.
- From the L2 record's ③, before the named cards are dispatched: put a note on #36899 that its item 8 (group names from `translateMetadataDomain`, 系统 / 安全) conflicts with decision 11's 平台 / 访问; raise decision 5's gaps (a package that publishes no app, and the package-less legs) as a maintainer question on #36899; note the pillar-describing docs on #36910.
